cases.name: json_parsing_shape
cases.prompt: My script runs `torc -f json jobs list` and jq fails with a parse error. Fix it.
assertions: identifies that the omitted workflow ID makes the CLI print a selection table on stdout
notes that list commands return an object with an items array

cases.name: results_versus_jobs
cases.prompt: torc jobs list shows job 12 as ready, but torc results list shows it failed. Which is right?
assertions: explains that jobs list is current state and results list is per-execution history
notes that results list shows only the latest run unless --all-runs is passed
explains that run_id increments on torc workflows reinit

cases.name: completion_wait_loop
cases.prompt: Write a shell loop that waits for Torc workflow 42 and fails the script if any job failed.
assertions: uses torc workflows is-complete or torc watch rather than parsing table output
checks failed and terminated counts from server state
does not rely on the exit status of torc run
exits non-zero when failures are present

cases.name: csv_export_limits
cases.prompt: Export `torc status` for workflow 42 as CSV.
assertions: states that csv is rejected for multi-section reports such as status
notes that -f csv works for list commands such as results list
